title: Sample Prep for ELISA Test of Monoclonal Antibodies
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Prepare 100 µg/mL mAb210
steps.instruction: Add diluent to the mAb210 100 µg/mL tube, then add mAb210 stock to the same tube and mix the tube 10 times.

substeps.instruction: Transfer diluent to the mAb210 100 µg/mL tube.
Transfer mAb210 stock to the mAb210 100 µg/mL tube.
Mix the mAb210 100 µg/mL tube by pipetting up and down 10 repetitions.

steps.title: Prepare 20 µg/mL mAb210
steps.instruction: Repeat the diluent addition, stock addition, and mixing steps for a 20 µg/mL mAb210 solution.

substeps.instruction: Transfer diluent to the mAb210 20 µg/mL tube.
Transfer mAb210 stock to the mAb210 20 µg/mL tube.
Mix the mAb210 20 µg/mL tube 10 times.

steps.title: Prepare 2 µg/mL mAb210
steps.instruction: Repeat the diluent addition, stock addition, and mixing steps for a 2 µg/mL mAb210 solution.

substeps.instruction: Transfer diluent to the mAb210 2 µg/mL tube.
Transfer mAb210 stock to the mAb210 2 µg/mL tube.
Mix the mAb210 2 µg/mL tube 10 times.

steps.title: Add diluent to masterblock wells
steps.instruction: Transfer diluent to the following wells of the 96‑well masterblock: A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, G1, C2, E2, D1, D2, E1, F1, G1, G2, H1, H2.

steps.title: Add mAb207 to masterblock wells
steps.instruction: Transfer mAb207 antibody to the same wells listed above (A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, G1, C2, E2, D1, D2, E1, F1, G1, G2, H1, H2).

steps.title: Add diluent and mAb210 to column 3
steps.instruction: Transfer diluent and the appropriate mAb210 solution (100 µg/mL, 20 µg/mL, or 2 µg/mL as required) to all wells in column 3 (A3, B3, C3, D3, E3, F3, G3, H3) of the masterblock.

steps.title: Transfer 180 µL from row 1 to plates 1‑2
steps.instruction: From masterblock wells A1, B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1, and H1, transfer 180 µL each to wells A1, C1, E1, G1, I1, K1, M1, and O1 on control plate 1 and control plate 2.

steps.title: Transfer 80 µL from row 1 to plate 3
steps.instruction: From masterblock wells A1, B1, C1, D1, E1, F1, G1, and H1, transfer 80 µL each to wells A1, C1, E1, G1, I1, K1, M1, and O1 on control plate 3.

steps.title: Transfer 180 µL from row 2 to plates 1‑2
steps.instruction: From masterblock wells A2, B2, C2, D2, E2, F2, G2, and H2, transfer 180 µL each to wells B1, D1, F1, H1, J1, L1, N1, and P1 on control plate 1 and control plate 2.

steps.title: Transfer 80 µL from row 2 to plate 3
steps.instruction: From masterblock wells A2, B2, C2, D2, E2, F2, G2, and H2, transfer 80 µL each to wells B1, D1, F1, H1, J1, L1, N1, and P1 on control plate 3.

steps.title: Transfer 180 µL from row 3 (odd columns) to plates 1‑2
steps.instruction: From masterblock wells A3, B3, C3, D3, E3, F3, G3, and H3, transfer 180 µL each to wells A2, C2, E2, G2, I2, K2, M2, and O2 on control plate 1 and control plate 2.

steps.title: Transfer 80 µL from row 3 (odd columns) to plate 3
steps.instruction: From masterblock wells A3, B3, C3, D3, E3, F3, G3, and H3, transfer 80 µL each to wells A2, C2, E2, G2, I2, K2, M2, and O2 on control plate 3.

steps.title: Transfer 180 µL from row 3 (even columns) to plates 1‑2
steps.instruction: From masterblock wells A3, B3, C3, D3, E3, F3, G3, and H3, transfer 180 µL each to wells B2, D2, F2, H2, J2, L2, N2, and P2 on control plate 1 and control plate 2.

steps.title: Transfer 80 µL from row 3 (even columns) to plate 3
steps.instruction: From masterblock wells A3, B3, C3, D3, E3, F3, G3, and H3, transfer 80 µL each to wells B2, D2, F2, H2, J2, L2, N2, and P2 on control plate 3.
